title: Niemand liest deinen Lebenslauf? Schau hier hin 👀
description: Nobody reads your CV / your CV never reaches a recruiter: ATS software filters or rejects CVs before a human sees them; pretty/creative CVs fail the ATS. Examples: 'NIKO ne cita tvoj CV', 'pov: alles Lügen', 'POV: cały czas dostajesz odmowy', 'Mach das nicht!! abgelehnt'.

title: 2026 Abschluss – aber noch kein Job? 😭
description: How am I supposed to explain this to my parents? Graduated (2026) and can't find a job; parents/family don't understand how job hunting works today. Examples: 'kako OVO da objasnim roditeljima', 'Jak mam wyjaśnić rodzicom', 'Wie soll ich das meinen Eltern erklären'.

title: Jobsuche: Ja, nein oder vielleicht?
description: Rating or ranking job-search websites/apps: YES/NO/MAYBE, good/better/best, tier list, top 3 job sites; the CV tool wins. Examples: 'Stranice za traženje posla NE/MOŽDA/DA', 'meglio / bene / perfetto', 'dobrze / lepiej / idealnie'.

title: Seit wann kann LinkedIn das? 🤯
description: LinkedIn job-search hack: change the time filter in the URL (86400 -> 3600, r3600) to see jobs posted in the last hour, then tailor the CV. Example: 'OD KAD LINKEDIN MOŽE OVO???'.

title: POV: Dein Lebenslauf bekommt endlich ein Upgrade 🤯
description: POV: I finally understand why everyone is deleting ChatGPT - usually no voiceover, on-screen numbered steps (copy job ad, paste into the tool, CV gets tailored) with music.

title: Monatelang Bewerbungen – und kaum Antworten? 😭
description: I got 20 interviews? / my inbox is full of interview invitations: shows an email inbox full of interview invites as proof, then explains the CV change. Examples: 'dobila sam 20 INTERVJUA', 'WAR IS OVER (tak wygląda moja poczta)'.

title: Der Recruiter-Tipp, den ich gerne früher gehört hätte 🤫
description: My brother/sister/best friend/relative is a recruiter or in HR and this is how you find a job in 24h / they always find work - an insider relative's tip. Example: 'MOJ BRAT JE REGRUTER I EVO NACINA DA NADJETE POSAO ZA 24h'.

title: Für jede Stelle wieder den Lebenslauf umschreiben? 😩
description: I hate this: having to write a new CV and cover letter for every single job is exhausting; a friend showed me a tool that tailors it. Example: 'MRZIM OVO', '3 mois perdus à personnaliser mes CV'.

title: Kein Job ohne Erfahrung? Dieser Kreislauf nervt 😭
description: You don't need work experience to get a job / is work experience important? - missing experience is not why you're rejected, the CV is. Examples: 'NE TREBA VAM RADNO ISKUSTVO', 'NIE potrzebujesz doświadczenia'.

title: Den HR-Typen könnte ich heiraten 😳
description: I could marry/kiss the guy/girl from HR (or recruiter/CEO) because he showed me this - silent text hook with a dramatic reaction or odd task, then the tool demo. Examples: 'Stvarno bih se mogla udati za tipa iz HR-a', 'Je pourrais embrasser la personne qui m'a montré ça'.
